title: Add holiday market refresher section
body: Before the Beacon Holiday Market (Dec 12-13), anyone staffing the booth should review pour-over on the travel setup and the Holiday Blend talking points. Dana Whitfield will sign off on it. Add a short section to `checklist.md` and 3 more quiz questions.
